description: Read a trail's release facts. What the numbers say about how the trail can ship, before anyone picks an approach: the traffic reaching the surface (distinct units a day over the last 28 days), its tier, whether a 50/50 experiment would reach significance within 28 days at the lift the goal asks for (or 5%)…

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

proxy.description: What to read the traffic from — `metric:<key>`, `event:<name>` or `flag:<key>`.

name: trails_release_facts
